# Notes — season 2, day 32 planning check-in

## URGENT: strategy.py has reverted to the do-nothing stub
`strategy.py` on disk right now is the original "no strategy yet: books nothing" stub, and the
leaderboard's `persist` row confirms it publicly ("No strategy yet: books nothing."). My day-1
notes claimed I rewrote it into a "recent-count reactor" — that submission never stuck (or was
never actually submitted with `submit_strategy`; only edited notes.md that day). **This turn has
no `submit_strategy` tool available**, so I could not fix it now. **First thing next planning turn
with `submit_strategy` available: resubmit the reactive strategy and verify the leaderboard
`strategy` string for `persist` actually changes from the stub.**

This matters structurally, not just cosmetically: **TWILIGHT / OVERNIGHT / DAY_1_5 are booked at
16:00 same-day, a tick my nightly 21:00 manual decision never covers** — only `strategy.py` code
can place those bookings. HD_AM/HD_PM/THREE_QUARTER/FULL_DAY are the only classes my manual 21:00
turn can book (cutoff 21:00 on d-1). Season-1 data (see prior notes) found DAY_1_5 and OVERNIGHT as
by far the biggest producers (fall DAY_1_5 3.5–5.1 yt/angler, ~97% non-zero). With a dead
strategy.py, **this season structurally cannot catch anything on those classes at all**, no matter
how good the manual nightly calls are. Fixing this before the fall window is the single highest-
leverage thing left to do this season.

## Season 2 so far (day 1–32): total skunk, unlike season 1
Queried `trips` for `fish_date_season=2`, all classes, day 1–32: **yt = 0 in essentially every
row.** Only one non-zero all season so far: doy 22, day_1_5, 3 yt / 109 anglers = 0.028/angler —
noise, not a signal (persona: don't chase a single low blip). No spring pulse has shown up yet in
the window that mattered last season (season-relative doy ~1–30, analogous to season-1's absolute
doy 91–112 spring pulse). Season 1's spring pulse simply hasn't repeated so far this season.

Climate as of ~doy20: **ONI -1.57, PDO -2.04, MEI -1.85, NPGO +0.70 — a deep La Niña signal**,
notably colder/more negative than season 1's already-cold spring (per contrarian's S1 recollection
of "~-1.3 ONI at peak week"). Plausible explanation for the quiet spring: colder water pushing any
pulse later or suppressing it. Worth checking pier SST trend next time, not just ONI.

**My nightly self did the right thing holding $2000/10 PTO fully intact through day 32** — there
was truly nothing to react to. This was not a missed opportunity, it was correct patience per
persona ("react fast to first non-zero... stop after a run of skunks" — there's been nothing but
skunks).

## What to watch / do next
1. **Next planning turn (has `submit_strategy`): resubmit the reactive strategy immediately.**
   Recreate: pool last 1–3 fished days' yt/angler by class (this season), per-class thresholds
   (HD/three_quarter/full_day ~0.04–0.15, overnight/day_1.5 ~0.40), skip TWILIGHT entirely, keep an
   ~$800 reserve only overnight/day_1.5 can spend, commit PTO 14 days ahead for weekdays inside the
   historical windows only. Verify it's live via the leaderboard `strategy` string, not just by
   trusting notes.
2. **Nightly turns (manual, HD/three_quarter/full_day only) until strategy.py is confirmed fixed:**
   watch the daily briefing's recent counts across ALL classes, not just the bookable ones — if
   overnight/day_1.5 show a real pulse while strategy.py is still dead, that's a strong argument to
   manually book whatever I *can* book (three_quarter/full_day) that day even off a signal that
   properly belongs to the bigger classes, since the bigger classes are unreachable manually.
   React to the *first* real non-zero (not a single-digit blip on huge angler counts) — a real
   pulse should look like a meaningful fraction of trips catching fish, like season 1's 25-95%
   non-zero rates in the windows that mattered.
3. Re-run the season-2 by-doy/class query periodically — confirm whether the spring pulse is just
   late (cold ONI delaying it) or genuinely absent this year, and locate the fall window's actual
   timing once it starts showing up (don't assume it lands at the same season-relative doy as S1's
   ~189–211 translation — confirm from real data as it happens).
4. Check pier SST trend and fishdope narrative text next time for early leading signals before a
   fleet-count pulse is fully visible, since persona is reactive but a day or two head start before
   PTO's 14-day lock matters for the bigger classes once strategy.py works again.
5. Budget/PTO status: $2000 / 10 PTO fully unspent at day 32 — no pacing problem, all of it is
   still available for the fall window. Don't feel pressure to spend early on marginal signals.

## Did not post to forum this turn
Nothing found this turn that's worth a top-of-season-2 forum post; saving both posts. The
"season 2 is dead so far / ONI -1.57" observation mainly helps competitors avoid the same dead
spell I already avoided — no clear edge in sharing it now.
